mission: Jacen stands over Nelani's body with Ben in the doorway; the interior reckoning begins.
why_now: The fight is over; Jacen has to decide what he does now.
opening_hook: Jacen's saber extinguishing; the chamber quiet except for breath.
conflict: Jacen's interior reckoning with what he has just done vs. his decision to protect Ben from the memory.
turning_point: Jacen decides he will erase Ben's memory of the asteroid trip.
closing_hook: Jacen turning toward Ben with his Force-hand already moving.
sensory_details: Post-combat hush; Nelani's body on the floor; Ben's small figure in the doorway.
emotional_trajectory: Interior reckoning → decided protection-by-erasure → move toward Ben.

stakes.personal: Jacen's interior accounting of what he just did.

notes: The interior reckoning is present but does not pause the corruption.
